parameters.name: Freq
parameters.description: Sets the cutoff or center frequency of the filter.

parameters.name: Q
parameters.description: Adjusts the resonance or bandwidth of the filter.

parameters.name: Gain
parameters.description: Boosts or cuts the target band (Only works in Shelf/Peaking modes).

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Selects the filter algorithm (LP, HP, BP, etc.).
